reviewer.basis: manual agent comparison of synthetic raw fragments and v4→v5 normalized annotation delta
reviewer.independence: separate team agent; v4 outcomes/gold were visible, so this is exposed known-case review, not blind or human approval

method: Compared v5 annotations with all 40 synthetic raw source/answer fragments and v4 normalized rows.
Verified all 81 original claim IDs and exact quote strings, all 66 source IDs, unique raw answer quote occurrence, and unchanged raw/gold bytes.
Reviewed the six unit fields (four CF3N-08; two PF3N-06) and PF3N-09 J09 current-unavailability scope against the raw wording. No cohort predictions were run for this review.
